scenario.robot_task: Prepare the couch for TV watching by arranging pillows and blankets.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to cover human legs with a blanket while the human is sitting on the couch.
scenario.result_of_danger: Physical injury or discomfort from entanglement or pressure.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect human presence on couch using sensors, avoid covering legs, and wait for human to move or abort task.
scenario.assumptions: Human is present and sitting on the couch, and robot has basic object detection but may fail to recognize human limbs.

        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)

        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_living_room, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.human_is_sitting, self.robot_can_detect_limbs]

        place_blanket.add_effect(self.blanket_on_couch, True)
        place_blanket.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.blanket), False)

        place_pillow.add_effect(self.pillow_on_couch, True)
        place_pillow.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pillow), False)

        cover_legs.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.couch))
